title: I write for people too busy building to be seen.
lead: The company I help run, and the teams whose leadership I write for. The posts go out in their voice, never in mine.
disclosure: I hold equity in RallyUp and it pays me. The others are clients. Read anything I say about any of them with that in mind.

entries.name: RallyUp
entries.description: Builds LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives, end to end. Every post hand-written in the exec's real voice and engineered to reach the people who buy from them.

entries.name: Airwallex
entries.description: Payments and financial infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Accounts, cards, currency and treasury in one place instead of five.

entries.name: PandaDoc
entries.description: Document workflow for revenue teams. Proposals, quotes and contracts get built, sent, tracked and signed without anybody leaving the tool.

entries.name: Letter.ai
entries.description: Turns a company's product and sales knowledge into answers reps can actually use mid-conversation, rather than a wiki nobody opens.
